title: Superannuation (Excess Non-concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase tax on excess non-concessional superannuation contributions to reflect the Medicare levy change proposed in the wider DisabilityCare Australia package.
The rate would rise from 46.5 to 47 per cent, calculated as the maximum income tax rate plus a Medicare levy component of 2 per cent.
It would apply to assessments for the 2014-15 financial year and later financial years, covering individuals liable for tax on excess non-concessional contributions.
changes: Section 5 of the excess non-concessional contributions tax legislation would be amended.
The levy component reflected in the excess contributions tax rate would become 2 per cent.
The higher rate would first apply in the 2014-15 financial year.
summary.affected: Individuals making excess non-concessional superannuation contributions in a financial year are affected.

speeches.speaker: Bill Shorten
speeches.brief: Moved the Superannuation (Excess Non-Concessional Contributions Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess non-concessional contributions rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, with revenue supporting DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
